neighbours.label: a token stating a contract's notice period or term for ending or changing it (by giving 30 days notice, a one-month notice, a fixed term); 'notice' in its ordinary senses stays low
fire: The tenant may cancel the agreement on giving two months written notice.
Under the contract, the employer must provide a 14-day notice before dismissal.
Either side can terminate the service with thirty days notice in writing.
The rental runs for an initial term of twelve months and then renews monthly.
Staff on probation can be let go with one week's notice.
The supplier may end this arrangement upon ninety days prior notice.
The mortgage has a fixed term of three years before the rate resets.
Members who wish to leave the club must give six weeks notice to the secretary.
quiet: The tenant noticed a crack in the kitchen wall last week.

notes: Card: peaks on ' notice' (90-day notice, without notice, written notice), ' for' (term for which the premises are demised), ' floating' (rate), 'ünd' (Kündigung), ' term'. Probe: 'terminate this lease by giving 60 days written notice' 1.280, 'end the tenancy with a one-month notice' 1.511, 'fixed term of five years ... variable rate' 0.642, 'Kündigung des Mietvertrags' 0.639, 'change without notice' 0.242; 'Did you notice' 0.003, 'posted a notice about the lost cat' 0.044, 'The term algorithm' 0.045.
